episodes.196609: Deep tropical moisture combined with instability aloft from an upper level trough led to heavy rain and flash flooding over portions of Oahu.
episodes.196673: A prefrontal trough, an approaching tropical wave, and the remnants of Tropical Storm Oscar combined to generate showers and thunderstorms across the area. The diurnal heating and the available moisture from these features also contributed to the development of strong convection across the interior and western Puerto Rico each afternoon. In general, 2 to 3 inches of rainfall were registered each day. This led to urban flooding, as well as mudslides in several municipalities.

events.narrative: Honolulu Firefighters rescued two people from Kaimuki Stream at around seven o clock a.m.
The 911 Call Center reported flooding on Calle Jose B. Acevedo near the intersection with Calle Luisa Gutierrez.

San Juan Emergency Managers called to report that, due to flooding, they closed the intersection between Simon Madera St. and PR-8 (Ramal 8) near the Mall of San Juan and Teodoro Moscoso Bridge. This is between San Jose Lake, Villa Olimpica Urbanization and Las Virtudes Urbanization.
Emergency managers reported flooded roadways between 65 de Infanteria Avenue and Barbosa Ave near the Petco store.
